test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about title block is/are true?

Statement 1: The title block is situated in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing

sheet.

Statement 2: The contents of the title block are standardised and cannot be modified to suit individual company needs.

options.text: Statement 1 is false, but statement 2 is true
Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false

solution:
The correct answer is __Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Title block__ is generally placed in the bottom right-hand corner of a drawing sheet.
 
• The title block contains essential information such as project name, company name, designer's name, date, scale, etc.
 
• It is customizable to meet the specific requirements of an individual company or organization.
 
• The layout and information within the title block can vary depending on the standards or conventions followed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Purpose of Title Block:**

 
 
• Provides clear identification of the drawing and its specifications.
 
• Helps in easy reference and categorization within a project.
 
 
 
• **Standardization:**
 
 
• Some industries use standardized formats for title blocks, but they can be adapted to suit organizational needs.
 
• Standards such as ISO or ANSI may specify guidelines for title blocks.
